links.comparator_used: General-purpose LLMs (GPT-5-Chat, GPT-4o-mini, Gemma-3-27B-IT, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Qwen3-32B) under standard decoding, versus the domain-specific DrugGPT
links.outcome: Confabulation rate (failure to recognize and reject a fabricated Pokémon medication) at baseline
links.effect: DrugGPT baseline confabulation 2.7-6.4% vs 47.2-99.6% for the other models
links.quote: DrugGPT demonstrated the lowest baseline confabulation rates (2.7-6.4%), whereas other models demonstrated substantially higher rates (47.2-99.6%).

links.effect: Deterministic decoding (temperature = 0) did not substantially change confabulation rates; no specific numbers reported in the abstract
links.quote: Deterministic decoding did not substantially impact confabulation rates.
